checks.title: Anyone can read table clients
checks.why: The public key ships to every visitor's browser by design. With no row-level security on this table, one query with that key returns every client.

checks.title: Secret key in browser code
checks.why: A service key skips every database rule, and this one is bundled into the code every visitor downloads.

checks.title: Payment code has no test
checks.why: Checkout and the payment webhook change with every prompt, and nothing checks that a failed payment stays failed.

checks.title: No tests
checks.why: There are no test files and no test script. A change can break sign-up and nobody notices until a user does.

checks.title: Crashes go unseen
checks.why: No error tracking is installed. When the app crashes for a user, you hear about it from the user, if at all.

checks.title: Nothing runs before deploy
checks.why: There is no workflow that runs checks on a change, so a broken change goes straight to users.

checks.title: File too big to change safely
checks.why: This page is 1,240 lines and holds half the app. Every edit there risks breaking something unrelated.

checks.title: Strict type checks off
checks.why: strictNullChecks is false, so the compiler lets a whole class of crashes through to users.

checks.title: No open write policies
checks.why: No policy lets an anonymous visitor change rows.

checks.title: No secrets in .env
checks.why: Only the public Supabase URL and key are committed. Those are meant to be public.

checks.title: No known-vulnerable packages
checks.why: None of the installed packages has a published security bug.

checks.title: Dependencies within one major version
checks.why: Every main dependency is at most one major version behind.

checks.title: Schema in the repo
checks.why: The database can be rebuilt from the migrations in the repo.
